name: Scroll Beat Kit
summary: Build scroll-driven 'beat' sections: a pinned stage where text and a visual move through four beats as the reader scrolls. The visual can be a product window, image, video or embed, and the moves include flip, spin, split into two or three, fold back into one, backflip, go responsive, and come apart in 3D. Ships a tested engine, a live gallery of every move, four text/visual layouts, one-file branding generated from any website URL, and checks that prove each deck is unclipped, well-timed and smooth in Safari and Chrome, on desktop and phone.
tagline: Scroll-driven product stories, rebranded from a URL

seed.prompt: The Scroll Beat Kit is now installed in this project as scroll/. It builds scroll-driven 'beat' sections: a pinned stage where text and a visual move through four beats as the reader scrolls. First read scroll/RESOURCE.md - its rules are binding - and follow its setup step (never overwrite an existing deck). Then start a local server in scroll/ (python3 -m http.server 8769) and open the move gallery with set_preview (http://localhost:8769/gallery.html) so I can see what the kit can do. Then ask me three things in ONE message: (1) what I build, (2) what the page is for, and (3) the website URL to take the brand from. When I give the URL, generate the brand with scripts/brand-from-url.cjs into a new deck folder and show me the gallery wearing my brand (gallery.html?brand=<deck>/brand.css) before proposing anything. Then propose four beats back as a table - the move each one uses and the line it says - and build only once I've approved them. Keep me posted in plain English as you go.
